title: SaaS product demo — warm paper UI walkthrough

source.author: @shownotover
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the XFastest demo; structure and pacing follow it. Brand, logo, creators, posts and numbers are ours and fictional.

scenes: research modal: pick niches, discover, progress, track creators
headline, then a flat chart that spikes to a multiplier
the spike becomes a post card, use this idea
editor: rewrite in your tone, typed line
whip to headline, whip to the coach panel: score, bars, reach range
pan to the bottom bar, schedule, calendar receives the post
green promise scene: follower chart and guarantee line
logo strokes fly in, wordmark slides out
